episodes.name: Area 51
episodes.overview: Hidden in the Nevada desert, a top-secret military base remains one of the most heavily restricted sites in the United States; since the 1950s, speculation has swirled about its true purpose-ranging from hiding experimental aircraft and even alien technology; Area 51 keeps its mysteries so closely guarded that not even the president is fully briefed; what is the government really hiding there?

episodes.name: The Hunt for Adolf Eichmann: Case Closed
episodes.overview: At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials were captured and tried for their crimes. But one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slipped through the cracks…repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.

episodes.name: The Legend of the Werewolf
episodes.overview: It's one of humanity's oldest nightmares-at the full moon, werewolves that once were men hunt human prey and then feast on their flesh. Stories of this terrifying transformation persist to this day.

episodes.name: The Theft of the Mona Lisa: Case Closed
episodes.overview: The world's most famous painting vanishes in a daring heist, sparking international outrage and a global manhunt. A master detective is called in, who zeroes in on a handful of suspects with the motive and means to pull off the theft.  Who stole the legendary Mona Lisa?

episodes.name: The Hunt for the Kraken
episodes.overview: It’s one of the most legendary monsters said to be lurking in the vast open seas. With stories going back hundreds of years, this elusive creature has terrorized sailors and baffled scientists.

episodes.name: The Murder of Sam Giancana
episodes.overview: The notorious mafia kingpin, Sam Giancana, is shot execution style in his own home. The larger-than-life mobster had many enemies, from inside the mafia to the CIA.

episodes.name: The Unabomber: Case Closed
episodes.overview: A twisted mastermind uses homemade bombs to terrorize the nation. Despite one of the most extensive manhunts in U.S. history, he still manages to stay one step ahead of law enforcement for nearly two decades.

episodes.name: Who Is the Boston Strangler?
episodes.overview: A series of shocking murders shake the city of Boston to its core. Each victim, 13 women in all, bore the signature of this serial killer.

episodes.name: The Plot to Kill Lincoln
episodes.overview: A shot rings out from the balcony of the Ford's Theater in Washington, D.C. and America's 16th president has been killed. Who was behind the plan to assassinate President Lincoln?

episodes.name: The Hunt for El Chapo: Case Closed
episodes.overview: El Chapo is an untouchable drug lord who sat atop a criminal empire and became the most wanted man in the world. How did investigators finally bring El Chapo to justice?

episodes.name: What Killed Bruce Lee?
episodes.overview: Bruce Lee was a seemingly invincible icon and the closest thing that we had to a real-life superhero. What killed him?

episodes.name: The Hunt for Viking Treasure
episodes.overview: Known for their seafaring skills and feared for their ferocity, the Vikings amassed gold, silver and other riches while trading and raiding across Europe; catches of this treasure have been found in Europe and North America, but this may be just the tip of the iceberg; are there any rich Viking hoards still waiting to be found? And if so, where are they?

episodes.name: The Lufthansa Heist
episodes.overview: On December 11, 1978, a gang of thieves lift around $5 million in cash and $800,000 in jewelry from a luxury airline hangar at New York's JFK Airport, marking the largest heist in U.S. history at that time.

episodes.name: Foo Fighters: WWII Edition
episodes.overview: During World War II, a fiery phenomenon terrorizes American airmen in the night skies over Europe. The pilots call these fireballs "Foo Fighters," and swear they move at over 200 mph and defy the laws of physics. But what are they?

episodes.name: Rommel's Gold: WWII Edition
episodes.overview: General Erwin Rommel captured territory, imprisoned local Jews in camps, and stole their gold and valuables in the name of the Führer. For decades, many have looked for this elusive treasure. What became of Rommel's gold?

episodes.name: The Shot Heard Round the World
episodes.overview: When the British Red Coats march into Lexington in 1775 prepared for a surprise attack, they are met with a small scrappy militia ready for a fight; it's the battle that kicked off the American Revolution, but centuries later, two questions remain: Who warned the Patriots that the British were coming and who fired the shot heard round the world?

episodes.name: The Death of Alexander the Great
episodes.overview: As one renowned military leader, his conquests were so decisive that some believed he was descended from the gods; at only 32, with a vast empire that was rapidly expanding, Alexander the Great died unexpectedly; what, or who, is responsible for the death of Alexander the Great?

episodes.name: Lost Civil War Gold
episodes.overview: In the final days of the Civil War, Confederate leaders fled south, rumored to be carrying the Confederate treasury worth an estimated $13 million in today's money. But when Jefferson Davis is captured, there's no treasure in his baggage. Where did the stolen money end up… and could it still be out there, waiting to be found?

episodes.name: The 2001 Anthrax Attacks
episodes.overview: Deadly anthrax spores sent through the mail kill five people and spread authorities thin. The FBI works around the clock to stop this brazen act of bioterrorism, but the letters keep coming.

episodes.name: The Hunt for Osama bin Laden: Case Closed
episodes.overview: Using new evidence to look at some of the most historically important mysteries of recent times.
